exact: phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase signaling/protein kinase B signal transduction

definition: An intracellular signaling cassette that starts with phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) activation, production of phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P), activation of PDK1, which recruits and ending with the activation of protein kinase B (PKB, also known as Akt). PI3K is activated by cell surface receptors. Note that PTEN is an inhibitor of the pathway.
label: AKT phosphorylates targets in the nucleus
